subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): openclaw worker mode running the embedded loop on the box

question: Does the worker command's launch, credential, workspace, local-tool, reconnect, and fail-stop boundary meet the security and lifecycle bar for landing milestone 2?
rationale: The branch deliberately creates a privileged remote execution surface whose acceptable containment and failure semantics are product-security decisions that tests alone cannot settle.

options.title: Approve after live boundary proof
options.body: Require a redacted end-to-end worker run plus explicit review of credential handling, workspace containment, fencing, reconnect, and teardown before merge.

options.title: Accept test-backed boundary
options.body: Merge based on the landed gateway contracts and extensive automated coverage while accepting that real provisioned-worker evidence will arrive with milestone 3.

options.title: Pause the composition
options.body: Keep the prerequisite RPCs landed but defer the executable worker runtime until placement and provisioning can supply full end-to-end proof.

recommendation.title: Approve after live boundary proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted end-to-end worker run plus explicit review of credential handling, workspace containment, fencing, reconnect, and teardown before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and carried the merged cloud-worker contracts and is best positioned to route the required security and lifecycle decision.
